title: OpenDraco: A Platform for Engineering and Experimenting with Configurable Multi-Agent Architectures for Software Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2610.32686v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Experimenting with LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) involves an iterative cycle of modeling configurations, executing and evaluating them, comparing results, and refining system designs. Existing approaches provide limited end-to-end support for this experimentation lifecycle. We present OpenDraco, an open-source platform that integrates these activities into a single workflow. OpenDraco represents agents, prompts, tools, models, parameters, and communication topology in exportable, versioned JSON specifications, translated into executable LangGraph workflows supporting different interaction structures. Users can modify and re-evaluate configurations using local or cloud-based LLMs. We instantiate OpenDraco for automated program repair (APR) and evaluate a sequential baseline and seven reconstructed configurations on synthetic and real-world SWE-bench Lite issues. translated_title: OpenDraco：一个用于构建和实验面向软件工程的可配置多智能体架构的平台
translated_abstract: 对基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）进行实验涉及一个迭代循环：建模配置、执行与评估、比较结果以及改进系统设计。现有方法对这一实验生命周期提供的端到端支持十分有限。我们提出了OpenDraco，一个开源平台，将这些活动整合到单一工作流中。OpenDraco以可导出、可版本化的JSON规范来表示智能体、提示词、工具、模型、参数和通信拓扑，并将其转换为支持不同交互结构的可执行LangGraph工作流。用户可以使用本地或云端LLM来修改和重新评估配置。我们将OpenDraco实例化用于自动程序修复（APR），并在合成及真实世界的SWE-bench Lite问题上评估了一个顺序基线配置和七个重构配置。结果揭示了不同配置之间存在显著的成本差异……
tldr: OpenDraco是一个开源平台，将基于LLM的多智能体系统的配置建模、执行、评估与改进整合到统一工作流中，并通过自动程序修复实验揭示了不同多智能体架构配置之间的显著成本差异。
en_tdlr: OpenDraco is an open-source platform that integrates the modeling, execution, evaluation, and refinement of LLM-based multi-agent system configurations into a single workflow, revealing substantial cost differences among configurations through automated program repair experiments.
